coverage: LLVM source coverage of facil.io 0.7.6's header-only HTTP/1 callback parser (lib/facil/http/parsers/http1_parser.h) driven through http1_parse on a writable, exactly sized copy of the request bytes from a C11 byte-input harness compiled with clang
parser_family: facil.io 0.7.6 HTTP/1 callback parser (lib/facil/http/parsers/http1_parser.h); an earlier, distinct distribution and API of the facil.io family later developed as C STL 0.8 (catalog package facil-cstl), so the two package paths share lineage and this path is not claimed as an independent parser family
